explain.ja: 将棋の囲いは、図1-1のように金2枚と銀1枚で囲うのが基本です。アマチュアでもプロでも、ほとんどの囲いは金2枚と銀1枚で作られ、これから紹介する囲いもすべてそうです。もう一枚の銀は攻めに使うのが基本です。
explain.en: The basic castle uses two golds and one silver, as in Figure 1-1. Almost all castles, amateur or professional, are built this way, and every castle introduced here too. The other silver is basically used for attack.

section.ja: 基本の囲いは金2枚と銀1枚で組む
section.en: The basic castle is built with two golds and one silver

title.ja: 図1-2 振り飛車の例 右に囲う
title.en: Figure 1-2: Ranging Rook example, castling to the right

explain.ja: 将棋の戦法は大きく居飛車と振り飛車に分かれます。居飛車は飛車を最初の位置から動かさず戦い、振り飛車は飛車を一度横に動かしてから戦います。囲いは飛車のない側に作るのが鉄則で、居飛車では左側、振り飛車では右側が基本です。飛車の近くは激しい戦いが起こりやすいので、玉は戦いの起こりにくい安全な場所に避難させます。
explain.en: Strategies divide broadly into Static Rook and Ranging Rook. Static Rook keeps the rook on its starting square, while Ranging Rook first moves the rook sideways. The rule is to build the castle on the side without the rook: on the left for Static Rook, on the right for Ranging Rook. Fierce fighting is likely near the rook, so the king is evacuated to a safe place where fighting is less likely.

section.ja: 飛車と反対側に囲いを作るのが基本
section.en: Basically, build the castle on the side opposite the rook

title.ja: 図1-3 横の攻めに強いが…
title.en: Figure 1-3: Strong against a side attack, but...

explain.ja: 囲いには、横からの攻めに強いものと縦からの攻めに強いものがあります。図2-1の囲いは、横からの攻めには金銀3枚でしっかり守れていますが、縦からの攻めには金銀がほとんど働いていません。囲いの特徴を知って使い分けることが大切です。
explain.en: Castles are generally either strong against attacks from the side or strong against attacks from the front. The castle in Figure 2-1 is well guarded by three gold/silver pieces against lateral attacks but those pieces barely function against vertical ones. It is important to know each castle's traits and choose accordingly.

section.ja: 縦に強い囲いと、横に強い囲いがある
section.en: There are castles strong vertically and castles strong horizontally

explain.ja: 「矢倉囲い」は初心者からプロまで使う定番の囲いです。組むまでに手数がかかり覚えづらい形ですが、居飛車を指したい人はがんばって覚えることをおすすめします。
explain.en: The Yagura castle is a standard used from beginners to professionals. It takes many moves to build and is hard to remember, but those who want to play Static Rook should learn it.

section.ja: 矢倉囲い:相居飛車で使える囲い
section.en: Yagura castle: a castle usable in Static Rook vs Static Rook

title.ja: 図2-2 矢倉囲いの使用例
title.en: Figure 2-2: Example use of the Yagura castle

explain.ja: 図2-2は矢倉囲いの使用例です。矢倉囲いは縦からの攻めに強く横からの攻めに弱いので、相居飛車で使われます。図2-2ではお互いが矢倉囲いに組んで、相手の飛車から攻められないように守っています。
explain.en: Figure 2-2 is an example of Yagura. Yagura is strong against attacks from the front and weak against lateral attacks, so it is used in double Static Rook games. In Figure 2-2 both sides have built Yagura to defend against the opponent's rook.

section.ja: 矢倉囲い:相居飛車で使える囲い
section.en: Yagura castle: a castle usable in Static Rook vs Static Rook

explain.ja: 図2-3は「舟囲い」です。少ない手数で囲えるのが特徴で、相手が振り飛車を取ってきたときに使われる代表的な囲いです。玉を左に囲うので、居飛車で用いられます。
explain.en: Figure 2-3 is the Funagakoi (boat castle). It can be built in few moves and is the typical castle used when the opponent plays Ranging Rook. The king is castled on the left, so it is used in Static Rook.

section.ja: 舟囲い:対振り飛車の基本の囲い
section.en: Funa-gakoi: the basic castle against Ranging Rook

title.ja: 図2-4 舟囲いの使用例
title.en: Figure 2-4: Example use of the Boat castle

explain.ja: 図2-4は舟囲いの使用例です。舟囲いは横からの攻めに強く縦からの攻めに弱いという特徴があります。図2-4のように相手が振り飛車なら、縦から飛車で攻められる心配がほとんどないので、舟囲いが活躍します。
explain.en: Figure 2-4 is an example of Funagakoi. It is strong against lateral attacks and weak against frontal ones. When the opponent plays Ranging Rook as in Figure 2-4, there is little worry about a frontal rook attack, so Funagakoi works well.

section.ja: 舟囲い:対振り飛車の基本の囲い
section.en: Funa-gakoi: the basic castle against Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 図2-5は「美濃囲い」で、振り飛車で使われる基本的な囲いです。縦からの攻めにはあまり強くありませんが、横からの攻めにはかなりの強さがあります。
explain.en: Figure 2-5 is the Mino castle, the basic castle in Ranging Rook. It is not very strong against frontal attacks but quite strong against lateral ones.

section.ja: 美濃囲い:振り飛車の基本的な囲い
section.en: Mino castle: the basic castle for Ranging Rook

title.ja: 図2-6 美濃囲いの使用例
title.en: Figure 2-6: Example use of the Mino castle

explain.ja: 図2-6は美濃囲いの使用例です。相手が居飛車なので、美濃囲いの弱点である縦からの攻めを受ける可能性が低くなります。振り飛車対居飛車の戦いで非常によく現れます。
explain.en: Figure 2-6 is an example of Mino. The opponent plays Static Rook, so the chance of a frontal attack, Mino's weakness, is low. It appears very often in Ranging Rook versus Static Rook games.

section.ja: 美濃囲い:振り飛車の基本的な囲い
section.en: Mino castle: the basic castle for Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 図2-7は「金無双」です。縦からの攻めには強い構えですが、横から攻められると下段がスカスカで弱くなります。玉を右に囲うので振り飛車で用いられます。
explain.en: Figure 2-7 is the Kin Muso (Gold Invincible) castle. It is strong against frontal attacks but weak against lateral ones because the lower ranks are empty. The king is castled on the right, so it is used in Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 金無双:相振り飛車の定番の囲い
section.en: Gold Musou: a standard castle in Double Ranging Rook

title.ja: 図2-8 金無双の使用例
title.en: Figure 2-8: Example use of the Gold Fortress

explain.ja: 図2-8は金無双の使用例で、お互いに振り飛車に構える相振り飛車で使われています。相振り飛車では玉を縦から攻める展開になりやすいので、美濃囲いよりも金無双を好む人も多いです。
explain.en: Figure 2-8 is an example of Kin Muso, used in double Ranging Rook where both sides play Ranging Rook. In double Ranging Rook the kings tend to be attacked frontally, so many players prefer Kin Muso over Mino.

section.ja: 金無双:相振り飛車の定番の囲い
section.en: Gold Musou: a standard castle in Double Ranging Rook
